hook: M G U, B Com Honours, Semester Six. Cost Accounting.
Tender or Quotations. Question thirteen, from Doctor Jayan's Cost Accounting Methods, page two ninety-two.
Same method as Question fourteen. New numbers.
Can you find the quotation price before I do? Let's go.
question: Here is the question. Following information has been obtained from the costing records of Alpha Manufacturing Company for the year twenty twenty-five.
Materials used, three lakh rupees.
Direct wages, two lakh forty thousand.
Factory overhead, sixty thousand.
Administration overhead, thirty thousand.

Prepare a cost sheet, and calculate the price which the company should quote for the manufacture of a machine requiring materials of two thousand five hundred rupees, and direct wages of one thousand five hundred rupees,
so that the price may yield a profit of twenty percent on the selling price.
Pause the video now, and try it yourself. Then check your answer with me.
step1: Step one. The cost sheet for the year twenty twenty-five.
Materials used, three lakh. Add direct wages, two lakh forty thousand.
Prime cost, five lakh forty thousand rupees.
Cost of production, six lakh thirty thousand rupees.
step2: One. Factory overhead rate, on direct wages.
Sixty thousand into hundred, over two lakh forty thousand. That is twenty-five percent.
Two. Administration overhead rate, on works cost.
Thirty thousand into hundred, over six lakh. That is five percent.
Twenty percent on sales is twenty, over hundred minus twenty, on cost.
Twenty over eighty, into hundred. Twenty-five percent on cost.
step3: Step three. The quotation price of the machine.
Materials, two thousand five hundred. Add direct wages, one thousand five hundred.
Add factory overhead, twenty-five percent of wages. One thousand five hundred into twenty-five, over hundred, is three hundred and seventy-five.
Works cost, four thousand three hundred and seventy-five rupees.
Add administration overhead, five percent of works cost. Four thousand three hundred and seventy-five into five, over hundred, is two hundred and eighteen rupees, seventy-five paise.
Cost of production, four thousand five hundred and ninety-three rupees, seventy-five paise.
Add profit. Four thousand five hundred and ninety-three rupees seventy-five paise, into twenty, over eighty, is one thousand one hundred and forty-eight rupees, forty-four paise.
Quotation price: five thousand seven hundred and forty-two rupees, nineteen paise. Rounded off, five thousand seven hundred and forty-two rupees.
tips: Two exam tips from this question.
Tip one. Different names, same idea. Factory overhead is works overhead, so it goes on direct wages. Administration overhead is establishment overhead, so it goes on works cost.

Tip two. Rounding. Profit works out to one thousand one hundred and forty-eight point four three seven five. Write it to two decimals: one thousand one hundred and forty-eight rupees, forty-four paise.
Then show the final price rounded off: five thousand seven hundred and forty-two rupees.
Quick check: one thousand one hundred and forty-eight rupees forty-four paise is twenty percent of the price. Correct!
recap: Cost sheet: cost of production, six lakh thirty thousand.
Rates: twenty-five percent, five percent, and twenty-five percent on cost.
Quotation price: five thousand seven hundred and forty-two rupees.
